data.description:
## Description
**What**: Add calibration auto-surfacing: the workflow scans accumulated GHA-artifact telemetry and, when the three-condition floor is met, auto-creates a single calibration-review story ticket with anti-anchor reference content.
**Why**: Calibration-first delivery — thresholds are human-set after the project has enough telemetry, surfaced automatically rather than relying on the maintainer to remember.
**Scope**:
- IN: floor requiring ALL of (>=20 PRs telemetry AND >=4 weeks since first telemetry run AND no existing mutation-calibration-review-tagged story); auto-create story titled "Review mutation testing telemetry and set per-stack thresholds" with body opening "Your observed kill rate is X%. What threshold fits your project's risk tolerance?" (number not headlined); reference-points table with p25/median/p75 rows and an "Approximate alert frequency" column; self-reflection prompt about non-test-PR windows; stable mutation-calibration-review tag dedup; config-consistency warning annotation when min_kill_rate is set but calibration.completed=false or vice versa.
- OUT: threshold enforcement and auto-bug-creation (draft-4).

## Done Definitions

- When this story is complete, the workflow auto-creates exactly one story ticket titled "Review mutation testing telemetry and set per-stack thresholds" only when all three floor conditions hold together: telemetry covers at least 20 PRs, at least 4 weeks have elapsed since the first telemetry run, and no mutation-calibration-review-tagged story already exists ← Satisfies: sc-4
- When this story is complete, the created story body opens with the observed-kill-rate question without headlining the number and includes a reference-points table with p25, median, and p75 rows plus an Approximate alert frequency column ← Satisfies: sc-4
- When this story is complete, the created story body includes the self-reflection prompt asking whether the calibration window includes test-file-modifying PRs ← Satisfies: sc-4
- When this story is complete, re-running the surfacing flow while a mutation-calibration-review-tagged story exists creates no duplicate story ← Satisfies: sc-4
- When this story is complete, the workflow emits a config-consistency warning annotation when mutation.threshold.<stack>.min_kill_rate is set while mutation.calibration.completed is false, and when calibration.completed is true while no threshold is set ← Satisfies: sc-4
- When this story is complete, unit tests written and passing for all new or modified logic (three-condition floor evaluation, dedup, reference-table computation, config-consistency annotation) ← Satisfies: sc-4

## Considerations

- [Anti-anchor] Per bot-psychologist: the observed kill rate must not be headlined and the alert-frequency column must use explicit headers so the maintainer is not anchored to a single number.
- [Observability] Per EXTERNAL FRAMING silent-sensor caution: consider surfacing low mutant-count / narrow operator coverage so a high kill rate is not misread as catch-power.

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
data.title: As a DSO maintainer, I want the workflow to auto-surface a calibration-review story once a telemetry floor is met, so that I am prompted to set per-stack thresholds at the right time.
